# Adam Renak

> Fractional product and engineering lead in London. Adam runs product and engineering for founders and early-stage companies until they can do it themselves. He trades as Adam Builds Tech Ltd.

## What he does

- Product leadership: owns the roadmap, runs the sprints and keeps the work tied to what the business needs.
- System architecture: chooses the stack and designs a system that holds up as the company grows.
- Your first dev team: hires the first engineers and sets up how they work.
- Rapid prototypes: gets an idea in front of real users in weeks.
- Making AI-built products safe: reviews software built quickly with AI tools and fixes what is risky.

## Work

- AIMICI: fractional leadership and engineering strategy running development with their overseas engineering team.
- Crossrisk: end-to-end build, ongoing. Started with the narrowest slice of the problem, tested it with customers, then built the platform out for launch.
- Loop Home: proof of concept for a chat-based marketplace for pre-loved furniture on a RAG pipeline; tested several concepts with real users and refined the proposition from their feedback.
- The Recruitment Network: launched their flagship training and professional development portal and built the in-house development team from scratch.
